claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game features microtransactions, downloadable content, and in-game marketing for fake digital currency.

citations.review_text: other than the microtransactions in paid games (which i personally do not like,) the game is actually pretty good, microtransactions aside. if you dont mind microtransaction in games like this, you should get off the reviews and buy the game already.

*jogo o jogo por 3h com meu amigo*
minha tela fica mais confusa do que minha namorada que me deixou depois de dizer que "precisava de um tempo", mas nunca especificou quanto tempo era esse, porque aparentemente "um tempo" pode significar duas semanas, três meses ou até o fim da civilização; continuou assistindo todos os meus stories em menos de cinco minutos, mas nunca respondia minhas mensagens; dizia que ainda gostava de mim, mas que "não era o momento"; falava que o problema não era eu, mas também nunca dizia qual era o problema; postava indireta sobre destino, energia, ciclos e recomeços toda terça-feira; curtia uma foto minha de 2022 às três da manhã e depois fingia que não aconteceu; me mandou um "oi" do nada, sumiu por mais duas semanas, voltou pedindo desculpa por sumir, sumiu de novo antes que eu pudesse responder, mudou a foto de perfil seis vezes em um mês, colocou uma música triste na bio, tirou a música, colocou um emoji de borboleta, tirou o emoji, bloqueou meu amigo, desbloqueou meu amigo, bloqueou de novo, falou que queria continuar sendo minha amiga, mas agia como se eu tivesse cometido um crime internacional toda vez que encontrava comigo por acaso e, sinceramente, até hoje eu não sei se terminamos, demos um tempo, brigamos, amadurecemos ou se eu participei involuntariamente de algum experimento social patrocinado por um departamento de psicologia.*
*continuamos até a wave 120 e meu amigo começa a reclamar do fps*
*meu fone fica com o som tão estourado que eu não consigo escutar nem o som do Benjamin ou do quincy*
*perdemos após o jogo ficar extremamente lagado e ser quase impossível de continuar*

jogaço da porra 10/10

Lovely game! 

I like when my friends and I get to the point where our screen just stop moving. Huge dopamine dispenser

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game features microtransactions, in-game purchases, and pop-up advertisements characteristic of mobile games.

citations.review_text:
I generally like tower defense games but I must be missing something with Bloons TD 6 because I have not had as good a time with it as the overwhelmingly positive reviews would suggest. I've given the game as much of a chance as I can but it has never clicked with me. My experience with this game has been one of mind numbing boredom where the level of strategy required with the inherent simplicity of the game is not enough to keep my brain actively engaged and the levels just drag on and on and never seem to end. I also can't get past the fact that it has the look and feel of a ♥♥♥♥♥♥ mobile game, with all the aggressive monetization tactics, pop-ups, and gimmicks that come with the label. It makes the game feel even lower quality than it is.

I don't get it.
Unfortunate that it has microtransactions, but very playable without them.
Fun but riddled with microtransactions and pop ups

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Long-term players praise the vast content variety, custom challenges, and steady developer support.

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as offering extensive content variety, including a multitude of maps, custom maps, towers, game modes, and heroes that keep gameplay fresh.

citations.review_text:
It's the one game that I can log on every day get my bloon poping fix and log off and feel like I completed something small for the day. 
Plenty of new modes, towers and heroes to keep most games fresh and interesting. 1400 hours at the time of this review says there is still plenty more hours in it for me and friends.

This is the definitive Bloons AND 2d tower defense experience. Nothing compares and you need not search for anything else. Lots of maps, custom maps, towers, game modes, skins. its got it all. Highly optimized with minimal bugs and fun easter eggs to discover. 10/10

claims.claim: Players report that the title receives consistent free updates and patches from the developers.

citations.review_text:
4 Stars out of 5 

BTD6 is a great game with A TON of depth and content & frequent FREE events. I've sunk an ungodly amount of hours into this game as a result. It's a 10/10 Tower Defense Single Player Experience. 

Emphasis on SINGLE PLAYER. 

The Coop in this game is godawful and makes you feel like you're back in 2002 using dial up. The game lags every 5 to 10 seconds causing micro freezes. It doesn't matter what type of internet someone has or how good their PC/device is, IT WILL FREEZE. 

If Ninja Kiwi could fix this, I'd give this game a 5 out of 5, but it's been years and I really doubt they can at this point.
Affordable price and excellent support, with frequent patches and updates

claims.claim: Reviewers highlight the availability of custom maps, challenges, and various difficulty levels.

citations.review_text: A very fun tower defense game about placing, upgrading, and buffing monkeys and other towers. There is many different difficulties and maps to play on.  You can make and play custom maps, challenges and more!

This is the definitive Bloons AND 2d tower defense experience. Nothing compares and you need not search for anything else. Lots of maps, custom maps, towers, game modes, skins. its got it all. Highly optimized with minimal bugs and fun easter eggs to discover. 10/10
